answer: I registered one phone. Ten seconds still, its accelerometer recording its tremor. No two chips tremble alike. That noise is the phone's beacon. No software can fake it. To claim, I repeat it live; the network checks the fresh noise for an echo of the registered one. A farm growing fakes like an orchard needs one real phone each, about $80,000 for a thousand. Heat shifts the noise, so my phone fails once in twenty readings and retries; a clone fails every time.
